name: US equity stress
summary: US stocks near highs and volatility contained despite the energy shock
state: US markets were closed over the weekend; the S&P 500 last closed on 30 Oct about 3% below its 52-week high, with the VIX at 19.4, just under the 20 Watch line. The coming week brings the 3 Nov US midterms and the 5 Nov Bank of England decision.
for_you: Conditions in US equities are calm by historical standards. Volatility near 20 means sharper daily swings are plausible if energy or rate news worsens.
rubric_hit: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
